text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from a walk, I bumped into Matikanetannhauser and the others
and decided to return to the academy together, but――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... To think I'd actually fall asleep
during a game of hide-and-seek...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, we were playing with some kids
as part of our volunteer activities just earlier.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But right in the middle of hide-and-seek,
I ended up dozing off...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to be so down about it!
Everyone looked like they had lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, Tannhauser-san.
Where in the world were you hiding?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even when the kids went home, we couldn't find you...
We started panicking that something happened to you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Since they said hide-and-seek at the park, I researched
a bunch of good spots beforehand~

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: N-No way...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Enough spots to fill an entire notebook...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's weird, though. I meant to hide in a spot
even kids could easily find――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that I'm so painfully average
that the kids just completely forgot about me!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it at all...
More like, it wasn't easy to find in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can't go on like this. I have to become a horse girl
overflowing with personality who stays in everyone's memory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! You already have plenty of personality
and leave a big impression!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for comforting me~.
But don't worry. I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Which brings me to you, as a professional Trainer!
I'd love to get some advice.
choice_data_list: I think you're great just the way you are.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course! Tracen Academy is packed
with super unique horse girls, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All righty! Time to go ask for some advice!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Individuality? Ah, I see... You wish to draw closer
to an peerless, one-and-only existence like mine?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Then put those feelings into song!
Come, perform it! Your very own aria!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees~! I waaaant to beee~!
A horse giiirl with lots of unique per-son-al-i-tyyy~~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: U-Um! Your singing is wonderful, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if that really fits
your own individuality, Tannhauser-san...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You wish to acquire individuality? Heh heh, a wonderful proposal!
Very well, I shall grant you my freshly brewed new medicine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With just a single sip, your physical body shall become a magnificent entity transcending the very potential of an umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: S-Something like that actually exists...?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: STOOOOOOP!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Th-That's way too dangerous~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she was stopped――
Matikanetannhauser's desire for "individuality"
continued on without end.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Just the way I am... does that mean
staying "ordinary"?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, ordinary or not...
Tannhauser-san, you're wonderful just as you are now!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The hardworking, earnest Tannhauser-san
we know right now is the very best.
choice_data_list: There's nothing for you to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hwah...! Everyone... thank you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Just the way I am, huh... Ehehe,
I feel kind of encouraged now~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Instead of agonizing over what to do...
I should just keep doing my best like I always have.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No more worrying, just straight ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll try out a super unique hairstyle and outfit!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: How did you reach that conclusion?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, the three of us desperately stopped Matikanetannhauser
as she tried picking out wigs and clothes
with completely lost senses of direction...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You say that... but you're just looking
out for me, right?! You're all so kind――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Kindness is a kind of individuality too!
In that case, if I'm super kind to lots of people...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Tannhauser-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I can help people in trouble,
or look for the lost cat on that flyer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... isn't that what you
always do anyway, Tannhauser-san...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yup, that sounds great, sounds great!
Now that that's settled, right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone!
I'm gonna go give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tannhauser-saaan?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sh-She ran off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser sprinted off with determination.
A short while after watching her leave――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...I found the cat, and I tried helping
people who were in trouble, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
When you think about it, helping people in trouble
is totally natural and "ordinary," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, trying to get a unique personality through kindness
just by doing normal things... What was I thinking...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Sigh, this is so embarrassing.
It's embarrassing, but... still...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I got to hear a lot more "thank you"s
than usual... ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to consider it a failure herself,
but there was no trace of regret
in Matikanetannhauser's smile.
